svg.title: Micropile underpinning — Undirstyrking með smástaurum
svg.desc: A shallow underpinning cap supports an existing wall on two slender outward-raking drilled micropiles.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-micropile-underpinning","label_en":"Micropile underpinning","label_is":"Undirstyrking með smástaurum","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["foundation","underpinning"],"description":"A shallow underpinning cap supports an existing wall on two slender outward-raking drilled micropiles.","design_note":"Small inclined pile shafts beneath an existing wall cap distinguish micropile support from a broad concrete underpin.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
